prompt: For each category, the report needs the product with the highest unit cost; when products of a category tie on unit cost, the one with the lower product_id is kept, so each category has exactly one row. Which query returns that, with the columns category_id, product_id and unit_cost_eur?

options.text:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY unit_cost_eur DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM products
)
SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT category_id, product_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id) = 1
